judge.rationale: The candidate has a broken test (`compiles static tool inputSchema at register time and reuses it on every execute call without re-reading` in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts`): because `execute` accesses `definition.inputSchema` on every call (`const schema = definition.inputSchema || {}`), `readCount` increments on each `execute` and fails `expect(readCount).toBe(initialReads)`. Furthermore, the candidate fails to meet several acceptance criteria: the tool-loop test was placed in a new `registry.acceptance.test.ts` instead of `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`; `docs/adding-a-tool.md` and `example/weather-tool.ts` still keep the defensive `|| 'Unknown'` fallback and bullet points telling executors to handle missing input; `.specify/spec.md` misses the required statements that a rejection is a tool result, that the tool-round bound stops retry cycles, and that extra properties pass through unmodified; and no warning log is emitted on validation failure. Finally, the candidate leaves behind an untracked `.lore/dod.md` artifact and sets the spec status to `In Progress`.
